locations.title: Joker Toxin in Guard Room
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165) and [Ultra Batclaw](#loc=148285).  

Same goes for the Teeth, the Patient Interview Tape and [Trophy #5](#loc=146221) - all collectibles in this area require you to get rid of the "Happy Gas".  

When you enter, take the corridor south (towards the room where the guards are) and, as you make a right, grapple up to the vents. 

Blow up a breakable wall and then pull down another one across the room. Throw a Batarang at the box and we're done.

With the vent with the Trophy to your left, jump the gap ahead and turn left. Climb and then grapple up. Turn left again, climb over the pipes and then crouch under the next. While crouched immediately turn left and you'll reach 2 walls. The Chronicle is behind the left one.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Don't cut yourself on this Sharply observed portrait.

**Solution:** Scan Warden Sharp's portrait on the west wall.

locations.title: Riddle #8 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Riddle:** A puzzle has many sides, but only some are visible.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

From inside the office, in Detective Mode, look south. The "top part" of the Riddler's iconic question mark is on the middle one of the 3 windows. The "dot" is on the wall outside, below a large, round vent.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Riddle:** You don't know Jack about Gotham. Tune in to find out.

**Solution:** Use Zoom Mode to check the radio, making sure the name Jack Ryder's clearly visible.

locations.title: Riddle #5 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Dr. Jonathan Crane plans on elevating fear to new depths.

**Solution:** Drop into the west elevator shaft and climb into a vent to the east. In it, follow the red-lit vent south until you reach a cave-like room (if you open the map you'll see you're basically in Cell Block Transfer). Scan that room.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Riddle:** A top hat and tails is the only dress code for this party in the North.

**Solution:** The poster of the Penguin on the south wall.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Riddle:** The legacy of this island has been well and truly buried.

**Solution:** There's an unearthed coffin in this general location. Zoom in on the headstone and Scan.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Gotham's greatest family towers over the city.

**Solution:** On the roof. Grapple to the clock tower (can do from the general location of [Riddler Trophy #7 - Arkham Island, East](#loc=145158)). Head to the northeast corner and look northeast toward the city. Zoom in on the building with the big W and Scan.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Riddle:** My challenges appear to those with the correct position in life.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

On the roof, at the top of the clock tower, next to [Riddler Trophy #1 - Arkham Island](#loc=145159). Go to the south side of the platform, look south and enter Detective Mode. The top part of the question mark is on the roof of the building below you; the dot is at your feet on the platform you're standing on. Align them and Scan.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Now I see it, now you don't.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

The top part is under the archway to the east (the one used to enter the building). The dot is on the underside of the "stone walkway" inside and up.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Riddle:** Let's face it, there are two Dents on the wall.

**Solution:** Scan the Dent posters on the south wall in the west guard room.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Tweedledum and Tweedledee SAW it, can you SEE it?

**Solution:** Scan the seesaw on the side of the road just as you reach the gate out of the asylum.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Ultra Batclaw](#loc=148285).

**Riddle:** Does Scarecrow's gas break down barriers as it drives you insane?

**Solution:** Grapple up to the "archway" closest to the gate to the east and look north and up. Pull down a high breakable wall, grapple to it and Scan the cannisters.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) with Range Amplifier upgrade.

**Riddle:** Zsasz is counting on you finding his work.

**Solution:** Scan the table with 3 dead guards "playing cards" in the guard room above the entrance to the building. The panel to overload is on the other side of the electric barrier.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Do you see what I can see? No? Then maybe I am in a stronger position.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

The top part is on the ground right in front of the door to the Penitentiary. The dot is on the railing on the ledge above said door (grapple up to it). Align the symbol from there (it takes a bit of movement and camera work).

locations.title: Riddle #7 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** TICK! TOCK! News flash! Someone is not getting out of here alive.

**Solution:** On the ground floor. Scan the cell with the skeletons.

locations.title: Riddle #5 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Riddle:** A question can only be answered from a new perspective. Don't you agree?

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

Blow up the breakable floor around this area on the second floor. Enter Detective Mode and face north. The top part is on the "wall" that was previously covered by the breakable floor; the dot is on the ground on the floor below.

locations.title: Riddle #4 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Was this fire fly too hot off the press?

**Solution:** Zoom in on the newspaper clips on the cabinet and Scan the one about Firefly.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Shhhhsshh! Rumors persist that Tommy Elliot operates in Arkham. Can it be true?

**Solution:** Scan the whiteboard on the second floor, west wall.

locations.title: Riddle #6 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** What silent killer of the oceans can be found in a tiny jar?

**Solution:** At the north side of the eastern examination table there's a small cart with a jar on it. After dealing with Scarecrow, zoom in and scan it.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Is this bear the Bane of his life?

**Solution:** Scan the bear on the desk.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Caves
locations.description:
**Riddle:** A puzzle has many sides, but only some are visible.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

Exactly in the spot where you found [Riddler Trophy #5 - Caves](#loc=145612), use Detective Mode and look west and a bit up. The dot is on the wall right in front of you and the top part on the underside of a bridge above.

locations.title: Riddle #4 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Who is the main man in the main hall?

**Solution:** Scan the portrait of Commissioner Gordon.

locations.title: Riddle #7 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Did Amadeus go mad, or was he just dizzy?

**Solution:** Scan the cell with the circular markings.

locations.title: Riddle #5 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** It'll be a cold day in Hell when this Ghul rises again.

**Solution:** Scan the toe tag of the corpse in the morgue.

locations.title: Riddle #9 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** How do you mask your feelings without losing control?

**Solution:** Scan the black skull-like mask on the wall of Dr. Young's actual office, right below the vent you used to enter.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** What does a bird need in the rain?

**Solution:** Scan the top hat and umbrellas in the glass display.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** This fiendish puzzle literally appears out of thin air.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

Enter Detective Mode and you'll see the top part on the west wall, next to the glass table. The dot is on the vent on the east side, you need to grapple up to it. It's on the same platform as [Chronicle of Arkham #1 - Arkham Mansion](#loc=146129).

locations.title: Riddle #8 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** A game of Cat and mouse can be painful.

**Solution:** Scan Catwoman's glass display.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Isn't the Warden too old for a puppet show?

**Solution:** Scan Scarface's glass display.

locations.title: Riddle #8 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** How do you reflect on your successes and failures, Batman?

**Solution:** Scan your reflection on the women's toilet's mirror (no need to Zoom, but you have to stand pretty close to it).

locations.title: Riddle #4 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** A case of mistaken identity?

**Solution:** Scan the person behind the glass wall.

locations.title: Riddle #5 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Two people, one voice, no gun?

**Solution:** Scan the tommy gun in the glass display on the north wall, on the second floor. Need to grapple up.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** This room is the end of days for even the most celebrated killer.

**Solution:** Scan the cell with all the calendar pages.

locations.title: Riddle #6 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** What has four walls, two sides, and one ex-DA?

**Solution:** Scan the "Vote Dent" poster on the wall of the cell.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** All alone in your cell? Why don't you break the ice with the most dangerous prisoners?

**Solution:** Scan the cell covered in ice.

locations.title: Riddle #8 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Is the number up for these guards?

**Solution:** Scan the 2 dead guards with the books.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** What time is tea time in Wonderland?

**Solution:** Scan the tea set on the second floor, northwest of the statue. From the south entrance, go up the stairs to your left.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Remember the Waynes? How could anyone forget?

**Solution:** Zoom in on the plaque on the bench and Scan it.

locations.title: Riddle #3 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** The Ratcatcher needed more than just his charm to lead his army.

**Solution:** Around this area the ground of the vent won't be a solid panel, but some iron bars. Below there's some gloves and other gear. Scan it.

locations.title: Riddle #4 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** This challenge can only be seen by those with a different view on life.

**Solution:** Scan the question mark.

(Follow the directions in [Riddler Trophy #8 - Botanical Gardens](#loc=147681) until you cut down the catwalk.)  
As you start crossing the catwalk, climb up a wall to your left and shimmy left until you can pull yourself up. Crouch under a pillar to go north and use Detective Mode. The question mark is on the ground, half of it on the platform you're on and half of it on a platform below.

locations.title: Riddle #5 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Looks like all the king's horses trampled all the king's men.

**Solution:** Scan the figurines on the bench.

locations.title: Riddle #6 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Is this a tribute to what a mad dog left behind?

**Solution:** Scan the plaque at the feet of the statue.

locations.title: Riddle #7 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Riddle:** There's no closet in the Gardens, so someone is using the roof instead.

**Solution:** From the spot where the cages landed, look west and up to see a skeleton. Grapple to a platform closer to it (like the one in the picture), zoom in and Scan.

locations.title: Riddle #6 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Riddle:** Hook up with the relatives before you're transferred out of here.  
**Solution:** Zoom in on the picture of Cash's family and Scan it.

locations.title: Riddle #7 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) and [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Riddle:** Even I was shocked when I saw how Maxie Zeus was treated!

**Solution:** Blow up the destructive wall and Scan the cell (almost any part of it works, like the drawings ahead of you).

locations.title: Riddle #4 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Riddle:** Where would I find my home sweet home?

**Solution:** Scan the cell.

locations.title: Riddle #6 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212), and [Line Launcher](#loc=147698) or Armor Upgrade...probably V4, depending on your skill.  
**Riddle:** Our records show that a Strange transfer request was made in this room.  
**Solution:** Scan the red folders on your right saying "STRANGE FILES".  
The room itself is safe, but the corridor is electrified and it hurts A LOT. Use the Line Launcher or roll through it. If you try to do it rolling, be advised that the camera repositions weirdly and you'll probably get stuck somewhere along the way, leading to death on the way out, if not on the way in. But I'm sure it's probably possible if you're skilled enough.

locations.title: Riddle #8 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Is the generosity of our benefactors on the Wayne?  
**Solution:** Scan the golden plaque on the wall.

locations.title: Riddle #1 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Riddle:** Are you going to take your hat off to Harley, Bats?

**Solution:** From the Sanatorium, pull down the high vent cover above the elevator and drop all the way down the elevator shaft. Access a vent there to reach this office.  
Scan the little mannequin (or head of one) with Harley's hat.

locations.title: Riddle #2 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698).  
**Riddle:** When is something right in front of you but still hidden from view?  
**Solution:** Scan the question mark.  
Go to the north room with the Batarang-destroyed box, look south and use Detective Mode.

locations.title: Riddle #7 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Riddle:** Prometheus, Arkham guards' most wanted and most hated.  
**Solution:** Zoom in and Scan the Wanted poster on the east wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the vent at ground level.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the vent at ground level.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of the vent, in a small cubicle on the north side just before exiting east. (Right in front of you when following this vent during the story, can't miss it).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: In a vent under the floor; access it by opening one of the two grates.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: **Location:** In the office.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the shack.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** Near the northeastern-most headstone, semi-hidden in the grass in front of it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** From [Chronicle of Arkham #1 - Arkham Island, East](#loc=145156). Looking east there's a ledge you can grapple to, leading to a small area with a lone pillar in the middle. The Trophy is behind it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Location:** Outside of the mansion, on the roof.  Go all the way east in the garden-like area and look way up. If you have trouble, grappling to the ledges on the north or south sides is easier.

This Trophy is practically above [Riddler Trophy #5 - Arkham Island](#loc=145157).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof. Grapple to the very top of the clock tower (can do from the general location of [Riddle #2 - Arkham Island](#loc=145146), on the east side). Move to the west side and the Trophy will be right in front of the clock.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** From the top of the clock tower, the southwest corner. Look southwest and there will be a tower-like building with an "open" roof. Below it, to your left, there's a metal fence. The Trophy is in front of it; jump/glide there.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the northern guard tower (probably need to grapple up twice).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description: **Location:** On the ground in this small "protrusion".

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the abandoned building, ground floor, close to the south wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** On the ground, between the two guard houses, there's a breakable floor (use Detective Mode if you can't find it). Stand on top of it and use the Gel.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the western guard tower.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description: **Location:** On a large stone "cliff". Reach it by gliding northeast from the roof of the western guard tower ([Riddler Trophy #10 - Arkham Island, North](#loc=145174)).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof. Grapple up to a ledge a bit to the west of this pin (on the north side) and then walk east over the slanted roof.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description: **Location:** On the rooftop.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the shack, on the southeast side, in front of the tires.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #11 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the guard tower, semi-hidden in the bushes.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description: **Location:** At the bottom of the waterfall, in front of a drainage ditch.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #13 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description: **Location:** On a ledge above the door.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Medical Facility
locations.description: **Location:** In the fenced-off room (in Maintenance Access). Reach it by following the vent to an intersection and taking the path to your right.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Medical Facility
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

On the ground floor, behind a breakable wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Medical Facility
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of this small room.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Medical Facility
locations.description: **Location:** Enter the vent from any of the "entrances", from the main corridor.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Medical Facility
locations.description: **Location:** In the vent, at ground level (technically second level, but accessible on foot, no need to grapple or anything).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Medical Facility
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the room where Quinn held Gordon prisoner. During story you had to grapple up before crashing down through the glass ceiling. The Trophy is right on the ledge, impossible to miss.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description: **Location:** Just before entering the tunnel to the Batcave, look above to a ledge you can grapple to. The Trophy is in a small tunnel there.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #11 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).  
**Location:** Activate Detective Mode in this room with the skulls in the center to find a destructible wall with the Trophy behind it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** In a vent just above the corpse. Open it with the Batclaw and grapple up to it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** Behind the breakable wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #16 - Caves
locations.description: **Location:** From the entrance to the area (ground level, south side), make a right and climb into a sort of hollow pillar that will be on your left. Jump across to a walkway and turn left (west). Drop down to a second walkway and then jump to a third. The Trophy's around the corner.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #17 - Caves
locations.description:
**Location:** In a room-of-sorts inside a pillar.

From the entrance to the area (ground level, south side), make a right and climb into a sort of hollow pillar that will be on your left. Jump across to a walkway and turn right (east). Jump to a second walkway, turn around the corner and jump the gap. On your left there will be a ledge you can shimmy on. Follow it around the corner and climb into the pillar.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Caves
locations.description:
**Location:** In a room-of-sorts inside a pillar, on the "second level".

While progressing through the story you'll climb up a collapsed pillar west of [Joker Teeth x 2](#loc=145601). After proceeding a bit more you'll reach some sort of aqueduct.  
The Trophy is in front of you, can't miss it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Caves
locations.description:
**Location:** In a pillar, on the "third level".

From the aqueduct mentioned in [Riddler Trophy #7 - Caves](#loc=145610), go up a second collapsed pillar. When you reach the platform at the end, notice a ledge you can shimmy on to your left. Do so around the corner and pull yourself up twice.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).  
**Location:** From the door to the Mansion, in Detective Mode, you can see a destructible floor on the ground just a bit to the northeast.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** In a vent on ground level. From the bottom of the stairs, facing north, it's on your right.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** In a hollow in the pedestal of the huge statue.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** On the desk in this room behind iron bars. Access it through the vent to the northwest.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof (of sorts) of this area. Access it through the vent north of [Riddle #7 - Arkham Mansion](#loc=146113).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** In the vent.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a vent at the very top floor, the same level from which you cut down the chandelier. Probably need to grapple up twice.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** Inside a vent on the ground floor (excluding the basement where the hostages were), the level with the glass floor.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Arkham Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** On a desk in the office.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #12 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** Behind some iron bars. Grapple up and get rid of the destructible floor/roof. Accessed from the Abandoned Tunnel just south.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** In a vent to your right just before entering the building.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Penitentiary
locations.description: **Location:** In the last toilet stall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** Behind a breakable wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** Behind a breakable wall, in a cell on the second floor.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Location:** In a cell on the second floor, behind iron bars. Overload the box right beside it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Penitentiary
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a cell.  The door will open after you save Warden Sharp in the room to the south.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Penitentiary
locations.description: **Location:** In the cell.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** In a vent accessed from the Guard Room after saving the 2 guards from Quinn. In the hall leading south and then west, the vent entrance is up on the east wall.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** In a cell behind iron bars. Need to blow up a breakable wall on the second floor and drop down.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Location:** Just inside Cell 5. Overload the control panel for it in the room where Quinn was, south of [Patient Interview Tape #1 - Penitentiary](#loc=146234).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Location:** On ground level, under the service lift; overload the panel right next to it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) with Range Amplifier upgrade.

**Location:** In a guard room above the entrance to the building. The panel is on the other side of the electric barrier.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Arkham Island, West
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514)  

**Location:** From the southwest entrance look northeast and up and grapple up to a vent. From there, walk a bit northeast and find a second vent looking southeast and up.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Arkham Island, North
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) with Range Amplifier upgrade.

**Location:** In a guard tower just outside the abandoned building. Grapple up to the door; the panel is on the other side of the electric barrier. (Reportedly, may be able to get it without the upgrade if you stand at the very limit of the barrier before taking damage).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #11 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Location:** On the floor in the room in the mountain. Access it from either of the guard towers to the east. The Trophy is between the 2 fenced off "offices".

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Arkham Island, East
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).

**Location:** On a desk in the guardhouse.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description: **Location:** On the second floor, directly north of the statue. There are some metal grates on the floor shaped like a T. Trophy's inside.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #5 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Requires** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165).

**Location:** In a vent on the ground floor (actually below, you need to drop to the base of the statue/fountain). There's a breakable wall northwest of the statue, right below the tea set in [Riddle #1 - Botanical Gardens](#loc=147614).

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) with Range Amplifier upgrade.

**Location:** On the third level, behind the electric barrier (the panel to overload also behind the barrier). The Trophy is on a desk to your left as you enter the room.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description: **Location:** In the vent.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Location:** In a fenced off room, below ground level.

From the south entrance to the area, drop down to the very bottom (water level) and go to the north side. There will be a metal grate on the ground; enter it and follow it south until you can pop out in the aforementioned room.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #7 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Location:** At the end of the sewage drain.

On the bottom (water) level go to the northeast corner and drop down yet a bit more, then follow the water south.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Location:** From the south entrance drop down to the bottom level and go up the stairs in front of you, then go up the stairs going east.

At the top turn north and jump the gap, then jump the gap west (careful not to bonk into the pipe). Go west and climb up the wall to the ledge you can shimmy on and go south, pulling yourself up when you reach the water.

Turn around (you're now facing east) and jump the gap, then walk a bit south and cut the rope holding up the catwalk to the east.  
Finally, cross the catwalk, turn north and jump the gap to reach the Trophy.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Requires:** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698)  

**Location:** When exiting this area, don't aim the Line Launcher at the door to the east, but rather at this alcove to the southeast.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #6 - Botanical Gardens
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698)
 
**Location:** On the ground after using the Launcher. You need to come this way during story progression, can't miss it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description: **Location:** From the south entrance, pry open a vent cover to your right, on the ground. Get in and make a left, then another left and immediately a right; kick the vent cover open. The Trophy is in front of you behind a fence; climb to the low platform to your left to reach an entrance.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** Midway up the elevator shafts.

From the ground floor. At the southeast corner, next to the stairs, look north and up. Grapple to the closest (highest) platform. Turn around and jump into a ledge you can shimmy on.  
Follow it right and climb up into a vent. After getting out, to your right, grapple up twice and immediately turn left. The Trophy is in a vent in front of you. Take off the cover with the Batclaw and carefully jump to it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212).  
**Location:** Climb up the ladder in the office.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Intensive Treatment
locations.description:
**Requires** [Cryptographic Sequencer](#loc=146212) and [Batclaw](#loc=145514).

**Location:** Climb up the stairs to the second floor and you'll see a vent up in the wall in front of you as you reach the top. The Trophy's inside.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #11 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698).  
**Location:** On a platform right above the water (it's in plain sight). Use the Line Launcher from the corridor just northwest of here.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #2 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698).

**Location:** Across the gap, in plain sight.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #3 - Caves
locations.description:
**Location:** On the lowest level of this cliff; may have seen it during the cutscene.


Accessible while leaving the Batcave, after obtaining Ultra-Batclaw.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #10 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698).  
**Location:** From inside the cave southwest of here, grapple up to the lowest edge (the one to the northeast). You can step outside to a small platform, and from there glide to the Trophy.  
To get back, use the Line Launcher towards the southwest to return to the cave area, and then grapple up back to the platform from which you glided.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #4 - Caves
locations.description:
**Requires** [Ultra Batclaw](#loc=148285).

**Location:** In a room in the ceiling. Pull down the destructible roof and grapple up to it.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #8 - Caves
locations.description: **Location:** Near the top, east from the Pump Control Room (whose breakable wall you had to pull down). With said room behind you, look right and slightly below.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #1 - Botanical Gardens

**Location:** Behind a high breakable wall.

You need to use the Ultra Batclaw from the end of the catwalk ([Riddler Trophy #8 - Botanical Gardens](#loc=147681) for reference if you get lost). Then, try to jump into it from the nearby platform or grapple up from a lower floor.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Arkham Mansion

**Requires** [Ultra Batclaw](#loc=148285).

When accessing this area from the east, the high breakable wall to pull down will be on your left if you go north in the main hallway.

locations.title: Riddler Trophy #9 - Penitentiary
locations.description:
**Requires** [Line Launcher](#loc=147698).

locations.title: Achievement - Night Glider
locations.description: From the top of the clock tower, the northwest corner, jump and glide heading constantly northwest. Aim towards the "road" heading to Arkham North.

locations.title: Achievement Recommendation - Mano-a-mano
locations.description:
You must defeat a Titan **without** using Batarangs.

You basically want to make them run into each other. Dodge the charge of one Titan and then get between that one and the other to try and make them crash. When they get stunned, whack them. When one takes a knee, ride him and try to make him whack the other one.  
Rinse and repeat.

You can also try to use Explosive Gel to stun them.  
After one of them goes down, the Achievement should pop up. You can now use Batarangs on the last one.

locations.title: Achievement Recommendation - Freakshow Rodeo
locations.description:
Ride a Titan and knock down 10 thugs.  
There will be an event battle in this area after clearing the Control Room and the Pump Room, and it's a good place to try. Just use the common Titan tactics (Quick Batarang, dodge, whack him) until he takes a knee, ride him and try to aim him towards the thugs.

locations.title: Missable Achievement - Party Pooper
locations.description:
At the end of the game, right before the final battle, there will be a bunch of thugs "throwing a party". They don't attack you unless you attack first. Take them all out to get this Achievement.  
Reportedly, you only need to defeat the ones in the building, and not the 4 outside, but might as well just in case...

locations.title: Achievement Recommendation - Freeflow Combo 40
locations.description:
At the end of the game, right before the final battle, there will be a bunch of thugs "throwing a party". They don't attack you, but you can start a battle with them.  
You can get all of these Freeflow Combo Achievements in the Challenge Rooms (and probably need to hit Combo 40 anyway if you're aiming for them), but this is a good place to just get it out of the way. Plenty of enemies, but half of them just stand around while you deal with the other half.

locations.title: Zsasz
locations.description: Hardly even a Boss, since you can Glide Kick into Ground Takedown him for a 3-second defeat.

locations.title: Titan
locations.description: **Achievement note:** Can't get Mano-a-mano in this fight.

locations.title: Bane
locations.description: Fight takes place here, but actually triggers in the Experimental Chamber just east after rescuing Gordon.

locations.title: Scarecrow
locations.description: Appears after finding Dr. Young's formula and leaving the area.

locations.title: Scarecrow
locations.description: **Location:** When you enter this room and walk down the hall after the events in the Botanical Gardens.

locations.title: Poison Ivy
locations.description: In our second visit to the Gardens.

locations.title: Titan
locations.description: After disabling all the pumps.

locations.title: Killer Croc
locations.description:
I'VE GOT YOUR SCENT, BATMAN! I WILL HUNT YOU DOWN!

*He meant it.*

locations.title: Ra's al Ghul
locations.description: After solving this Riddle, if you return to the room some time later, his corpse is gone.

locations.title: Hidden Room
locations.description:
**Requires:** [Explosive Gel](#loc=145165)  
  
**Location:** Behind a hidden breakable wall. You cannot detect it (even in Detective Mode).

Approach the northern wall of the Warden's office and plant 3 Explosive Gels close together to bring it down. If you look REALLY close near the ground, you'll see a sort of "notch" indicating you're in the right place.

You might need to walk all the way to the other side of the room before detonating in order for it to work.

locations.title: Mysterious Inmate
locations.description: Winner of a Rocksteady contest.

locations.title: Joker Mannequin
locations.description:
**[SPOILERS BELOW]**...kinda.

**Location:** In the Visitor Center - Visitor Room.  
If you keep visiting this area during the game, you'll find a mannequin of the Joker with a TV for its head, and Joker will talk to you through it. However, if you turn around and then look at it again, the "mannequin" will have changed positions, hinting at the fact that it was the real Joker all along!

locations.title: Steve
locations.description:
When passing by the phone, you may hear a woman calling the asylum to ask if Steve is OK.

The Joker replies that he'll look for him, calling back a few seconds later to say they'd found his head - just his head. Hahahaha!

locations.title: Alternate Cutscene
locations.description:
While following Harley's fingerprints, a typical playthrough will see you enter this room and witness the Joker kill a guard by kicking him into the electrified water. 

If you were to enter the generator room to the east first and disable the power via the box on the top floor, the Joker will comment on you being one step ahead, and a different cutscene plays when you enter this room.

locations.title: Explosive Gel
locations.description:
First gadget.

**Location:** In the Batmobile. Obtainable the first time you access Arkham North, after escaping Intensive Treatment.

locations.title: Batclaw
locations.description:
Second gadget.

**Location:** During a cutscene in the Batcave after rescuing Gordon.

locations.title: Cryptographic Sequencer
locations.description:
Third gadget.

**Location:** During the cutscene when releasing the Warden.

locations.title: Line Launcher
locations.description:
Fourth gadget.

**Location:** After the boss fight.

locations.title: Ultra Batclaw
locations.description:
Fifth and last gadget.

**Location:** During a cutscene in our second visit to the Batcave.
